purpose: Fresh-context outcome QA for source integration and distribution readiness, not code review.

criteria.detail: The Action Topbar workspace contains source, manifest, four test files, icon, license, and notices.
The root catalog and collection index include Action Topbar as experimental.
Both READMEs warn that the matching BB core and experimental Plugin SDK 0.4.33 are required and that marketplace submission is deferred.
The plugin README contains Git and local-path installation commands.
All 24 tests, TypeScript typechecking, plugin build, and dry-run package validation pass.

The clean integration worktree is based on origin/main and the staged product diff excludes unrelated changes from the original development worktree; the final push is reserved for the integration phase.

observations: The local BB CLI builds the plugin and reports that its own SDK is 0.4.30, confirming why the compatibility warning is necessary.
npm pack --dry-run includes both app and server bundles plus required documentation and icon assets.
